svg.title: Reputation of the house members, testnet demo
svg.desc: Line chart over 144 rounds. Grey lines: the five honest house members. Coloured: the newcomer, the colluding pair and the free rider. The dashed line is the reputation needed for automatic payouts.
svg.text: Reputation of the house members, testnet demo
Thanks of reputation (decayed points minus strikes); launch values, seed 1. Dashed: the minimum for tier 1.
